article.title: Qual y quais
article.part: Pronombres y referencia pronominal — Pronomes e referência pronominal
article.chapter: Posesivos, demostrativos, indefinidos e interrogativos — Possessivos, demonstrativos, indefinidos e interrogativos

claims.sectionKey: Qual y quais son formas interrogativas
claims.summary: Qual and quais are interrogative pronouns used to ask for identification or choice among possibilities.

claims.sectionKey: Qual es singular y quais es plural
claims.summary: Qual is singular and quais is plural; they do not change gender.

claims.sectionKey: Pueden aparecer sin un sustantivo expreso
claims.summary: Qual and quais can appear without an explicit noun; the context allows for the recovery of the set of options being questioned.

claims.sectionKey: También pueden acompañar a un sustantivo
claims.summary: Qual and quais can accompany a noun, especially in Brazilian Portuguese; the singular or plural form agrees with the grammatical number of the referenced object.

claims.sectionKey: Otra construcción frecuente es qual/quais de...
claims.summary: Another common construction is 'qual/quais de...'; this makes explicit the set among whose members a choice is being made.

links.notes: The article explicitly states that 'Qual' and 'quais' are interrogative pronouns used to ask for identification or choice among possibilities.
The article clearly states that 'Qual' is singular and 'quais' is plural, and they do not change gender.
The article provides examples where 'Qual' and 'quais' appear without an explicit noun, and the context allows for the recovery of the set of options being questioned.
The article provides examples where 'Qual' and 'quais' accompany a noun, and the singular or plural form agrees with the grammatical number of the referenced object.
The article provides examples of the construction 'qual/quais de...', which makes explicit the set among whose members a choice is being made.
